scope: Round-trip double precision in heuristics JSON; active-node and accepted-edge graph comparisons plus performance values.
limits: Finite EventLog graph observations: 80 fixed/seeded logs, both variants, three threshold profiles.
Exact numeric comparisons; active-node and edge list order is canonicalized by activity names only.
Only accepted edges, their numeric values and active nodes are compared here; this is not complete HeuristicsNet object equivalence.
No full parity or structural coverage upgrade is claimed.
Sixteen additional performance observations compare edge values, mean waits and PLUSPLUS mean sojourns, with ordinary and business time.
